# Text field

One line or several lines of text, with a label inside the filled box, a hint and an error.

- Status: implemented
- Category: input
- Pattern: HTML `<input>, <textarea> with <label>`
- Text style: `body` (`.nd-text-body`)

## Anatomy

- **label**: Always visible: inside the box, top left, while typing too.
- **control**: OpenNetwork text field.
- **hint** (optional): Format or purpose, linked with aria-describedby.
- **error** (optional): An icon and a sentence after the hint; the box border turns danger and thickens.
- **required-mark** (optional): Visible and in the label text.

## Variants

- `single-line`: input of type text, email, tel, url, search.
- `multi-line`: textarea, resizable vertically.
- `search`: A search box in a list's toolbar : the control height, the smaller radius, no fill; the label may be visually hidden inside a search landmark.

## States

- `default`
- `hover`
- `focus-visible`
- `disabled`: Dashed border, tertiary text.
- `readonly`: Dashed border, text stays primary.
- `invalid`: Thicker danger border, an icon and a written error; aria-invalid. The border also follows :user-invalid, after the person edits a field with a native constraint or tries to submit.

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves to and from the field. |

## Accessibility

- Role: textbox
- Name: The label element.
- autocomplete names personal data (1.3.5).
- Errors are announced through the error summary and linked to their field.
- A text area grows with its content up to twenty lines (field-sizing), then scrolls; it can still be resized.

## Platforms

| Platform | Implementation |
| --- | --- |
| web | .nd-field > label.nd-field__label + .nd-field__control |

Web: `.nd-field` in kit.css; modifiers `.nd-form`, `.nd-field--search`.

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-stack">
  <form class="nd-form nd-stack">
    <div class="nd-form__row">
      <div class="nd-field">
        <label class="nd-field__label" for="ex-name"
          >Name<span class="nd-field__required" aria-hidden="true"
            >*</span
          ></label
        >
        <input
          class="nd-field__control"
          id="ex-name"
          name="name"
          autocomplete="name"
          required
        />
      </div>
      <div class="nd-field">
        <label class="nd-field__label" for="ex-email">Email</label>
        <input
          class="nd-field__control"
          id="ex-email"
          type="email"
          autocomplete="email"
          aria-invalid="true"
          aria-describedby="ex-email-hint ex-email-error"
          value="name@"
        />
        <p class="nd-field__hint" id="ex-email-hint">
          We reply to this address.
        </p>
        <p class="nd-field__error" id="ex-email-error">
          Enter an address like name@example.org.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="nd-field">
      <label class="nd-field__label" for="ex-message">Message</label>
      <textarea class="nd-field__control" id="ex-message"></textarea>
    </div>
    <div class="nd-field">
      <label class="nd-field__label" for="ex-disabled">Disabled</label>
      <input
        class="nd-field__control"
        id="ex-disabled"
        disabled
        value="Not editable"
      />
    </div>
  </form>
  <form class="nd-field nd-field--search" role="search">
    <label class="nd-visually-hidden" for="ex-search"
      >Search the examples</label
    >
    <input
      class="nd-field__control"
      id="ex-search"
      type="search"
      placeholder="Search"
    />
  </form>
</div>
```
